newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate down, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate down, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 10.50 percent in late trade from 11.00 percent early on rising liquidity, dealers said.
"A higher amount of funds was offered in the market today. Fund demand was lower after the passing of reserve requirement yesterday," one dealer at a foreign bank said.
The baht edged higher to 25.468-25.473 to the dollar in late active trade from 25.472-25.475 in early morning.
"The dollar was bought heavily today on some dollar short covering. But the dollar's slight weakness in the late afternoon helped ease demand," said one currency dealer.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 9.00/10.00 satangs per dollar late against 8.50/9.00 in early morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.45 to the dollar compared with 25.46 on Thursday.
